title: Pro Shop Store Credit: top-up bonus rate and dues-standing gate
content:
## Applies to
Pro Shop Store Credit: this document covers the bonus portion of a top-up's crediting basis, for every tier of this product.

## Basis
The amount added to the account for a top-up begins with the tier's own standing top-up figure. On top of that figure, a bonus is added, equal to the greater of the tier's ordinary bonus-credit rate and its seasonal promotional rate, applied once -- the two rates are never both applied together, only the higher of the two, and the rate is applied to the tier's own standing top-up figure, not to any balance already on the account. The bonus is rounded to two decimal places at the point it is computed.

The bonus described above is granted only while the member's separately-held club membership account currently carries no outstanding dues balance. Where that membership account's dues balance is greater than zero, no bonus is credited on this top-up; only the tier's own standing top-up figure itself is added, before any balance ceiling is applied.

## Worked example (hypothetical)
Suppose a tier's ordinary bonus-credit rate is 5 percent and its seasonal promotional rate is 8 percent, and a member tops up 100.00 USD with no outstanding dues balance on their club membership account. The bonus credited is 8.00 USD -- 8 percent of the 100.00 USD top-up, applied once -- not 13.00 USD, which would result from wrongly adding the two rates together instead of taking only the higher one.

## Negative case (hypothetical)
Using the same tier and top-up as above, suppose instead that the member's club membership account currently shows a dues balance greater than zero. No bonus is credited on this top-up regardless of either rate; only the 100.00 USD standing top-up figure itself is added, before any balance ceiling is applied.
